data_classification: synthetic demonstration only; site-level aggregates for 40 sites of a fictional Singapore contract research organisation in 5 planning areas, no patient data

grains.RAW.SITES: one row per trial site (Singapore planning area and therapeutic area)
grains.RAW.SITE_DAILY: one row per site per day (90 days)
grains.RAW.ESSENTIAL_DOCUMENTS: one row per site (essential document snapshot)
grains.CURATED.SIGNAL_SUMMARY: one row per monitoring signal type

freshness: MAX(EVENT_DATE) is an observation watermark; requestedAt is not freshness

required_capabilities.core_pipeline: Curated KPIs reconcile to a RAW recomputation (run_core.py checks this on every build)
required_capabilities.deviation_risk_model: Snowflake ML CLASSIFICATION of P(confirmed important protocol deviation in next 7 days) per site, evaluated on an out-of-time holdout; operational, not clinical
required_capabilities.forecast_and_anomaly: 14-day network-wide enrollment FORECAST; data query rate ANOMALY_DETECTION (train 75 days, detect last 15)
required_capabilities.search: Cortex Search SEARCH.SITE_SOP_SEARCH over synthetic site-management SOPs (one per therapeutic area and signal type)
required_capabilities.semantic_analytics: Semantic view APP.TRIAL_OPS_ANALYTICS and Cortex Agent APP.TRIAL_OPS_AGENT using analyst + search tools
required_capabilities.grounded_ai: Agent answers return generated SQL and SOP citations; the action memo uses only KPI, site, signal-type and risk rows
required_capabilities.quicksight: DIRECT_QUERY dashboard (sites, daily enrollment and signals, important deviations by site, deviation risk, visit records loaded) through a read-only Snowflake service user
required_capabilities.quicksight_q: Amazon Q topic over the curated datasets for natural-language questions
required_capabilities.aws_ingestion: Amazon Data Firehose -> S3 -> Snowpipe AUTO_INGEST into RAW.LIVE_VISITS
required_capabilities.notifications: APP.LIVE_VISIT_ALERT logs new ALERT events to APP.ALERT_LOG and emails via SYSTEM$SEND_EMAIL; alert and tasks suspended between demos
required_capabilities.orchestration: Task graph APP.TASK_REFRESH_CURATED -> APP.TASK_RESCORE_RISK run on demand (EXECUTE TASK)

aws.memo: Amazon Bedrock Claude Sonnet 4.5 via APP.BEDROCK_GENERATE
